title: Coupon discount does not account for item quantity
description: With two units of the same product in the cart, applying the 10% coupon SAVE10 should discount 10% of the whole subtotal (2 x $89.90 = $179.80 -> $17.98), not 10% of a single unit. The plan adds the keyboard twice, anchors the quantity and the subtotal, applies SAVE10 and then reads the Discount amount shown in the cart summary.
preconditions: buggy-shop is running at the target URL
Every execution starts from a fresh browser context, hence a new session with an empty cart

The cart summary renders Subtotal / Discount / Total as a description list (dt/dd pairs), so the first dd is the subtotal amount and the second dd is the discount amount; the subtotal anchor verifies this mapping before the expectation is read

steps.description: The cart contains two units of the Mechanical Keyboard
The header badge reports two items in the cart
The subtotal amount shown in the cart summary is $179.80 (two keyboards)
After applying the coupon the subtotal is still $179.80, so the discount is computed on two keyboards
The discount amount is 10% of the full subtotal, i.e. $17.98

metadata.symptom: I added the same keyboard to my cart twice and applied the coupon SAVE10 (10% off), but the discount only took 10% off one keyboard instead of both.
